newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Montoro rules out '97 budget adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Montoro rules out '97 budget adjustment.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro ruled out on Monday the need for an adjustment to the 1997 budget, reaffirming the government's three percent growth forecast for 1997.
"There's no need to anticipate any adjustment given that the (1997) budget is austere," Montoro told journalists at an economic conference.
He said 1996 GDP growth of 2.5 percent in the fourth quarter "makes us think that in 1997 growth will be three percent as forecast and (government) revenues will be consistent with this forecast."
Montoro said exports in 1996 will have accounted for 0.5 percentage points of GDP growth, and 200,000 net jobs will have been created.
The Economy Secretary will present provisional estimates of 1996 economic data to parliament on Wednesday.
